verdict.rationale: Plausible exposes a Stats API (including a POST /api/v2/query endpoint) that an agent could use to pull metrics programmatically, and separately offers an Embed Dashboard feature, but there is no evidence of an MCP server, no API for programmatically creating/configuring a dashboard, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for agent tooling. missing for 10: MCP server, an API to build/configure a dashboard (not just query stats), machine-readable API spec (openapi/llms.txt all 404), and any hands-on evidence of an agent completing this workflow end-to-end.
